<p class="page-lead">I am an Assistant Professor at SANKEN, Osaka University, working on data mining and machine learning for complex, evolving data.</p>

## Background

I received my Ph.D. in Information Science from Osaka University in 2021. My work spans data-stream processing, tensor decomposition, anomaly detection, and time-series analysis, with an emphasis on algorithms that are both mathematically grounded and useful in real-world settings.
